subject: AuroraAI dedicated compute — post-call summary & action map
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Rourke <liam@auroraai.com>, Anjali Rao <anjali@auroraai.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: AuroraAI dedicated compute — post-call summary & action map

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the candid discussion. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Key pain points you reiterated:
- Peak latency variability on synchronous inference (95th percentile spikes to ~600ms on current infra).
- Multi-tenant noisy neighbor impacts during model training runs that overlap inference windows.
- Unpredictable monthly spend when burst capacity is used for batch jobs.

Goals you shared:
1) Stable P95 latency < 200ms for the customer-facing endpoint (steady-state).
2) Isolation for PHI/PII workloads (VPC + dedicated GPU pool).
3) Predictable monthly committed spend with a burst policy for one-off training jobs.

Our alignment and asks (next steps):
- Redwood proposal: Dedicated reserved GPU pool (isolation lane) + canary period with traffic shaping. Suggested initial commitment: 4 x A100-equivalent slots for the first 6 months, with automated burst to a shared pool for scheduled batch training.
- SLA targets draft: 99.5% availability for dedicated pool, P95 latency target 200ms for the pinned model variant. (Attached: AuroraAI-MVP-scope.pdf + AuroraAI-SLA-draft.docx)
- Security/compliance: we will include KMS integration and audit-log exports for the pool; engineering will share a minimal evidence pack for procurement.

Owners & timing we propose:
- Redwood: Naomi (commercial lead) + Sean (ops/onsite readiness).
- AuroraAI: Liam (product) + Anjali (infrastructure/procurement).
- Action window: mutual action plan kickoff next Tuesday (Jun 24) if procurement gating goes as discussed.

Requested asks for AuroraAI before the next call:
- Confirm whether PHI workloads require an air-gapped option or VPC-only (short reply OK).
- Provide ballpark committed monthly budget or range so we can size the reserved offer appropriately.
- Share a list of 3 realistic peak-hours (UTC) so we can model request distribution.

I'll follow up with a short mutual action plan and a DocuSign for the preliminary SLA/POA if you want to fast-track.

—
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: AuroraAI-MVP-scope.pdf (6 pages), AuroraAI-SLA-draft.docx (draft)
From: Liam O'Rourke <liam@auroraai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Anjali Rao <anjali@auroraai.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 16:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AuroraAI dedicated compute — post-call summary & action map

Naomi — thanks for the clear write-up, that matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Isolation: VPC + dedicated GPU pool is our preference to avoid procurement for air-gapped in the near term. We may revisit on-prem for a later phase.
2) Traffic pattern: peak traffic is 09:00–11:00 and 18:00–20:00 PT (roughly 16:00–18:00 and 01:00–03:00 UTC). There are predictable daily spikes and one weekly heavy batch window on Sundays.
3) Budget: rough target is $40k–$60k/month committed for the first 6 months (flexible if we see immediate ROI).
4) Canary: we'd like a two-week canary with 20% production traffic routed to the dedicated pool, with rollback triggers if error rate or latency degrades >15% over baseline.

On SLA language: 99.5% availability sounds fine, but can we add explicit fallbacks (auto-route to host pool) and an escalation path that includes a 2-hour page for Sev1?

We'll pull procurement into the thread if the SLA/POA looks good — Anjali will confirm procurement cadence tomorrow. I'm looping in a short note on constraints: we need the SLA evidence pack for our security review (SOC2 + KMS attestation).

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Liam O'Rourke
Head of Product, AuroraAI
liam@auroraai.com | +1 (206) 555-0199
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AuroraAI dedicated compute — post-call summary & action map

Naomi / Ben — quick internal note after reading Liam's reply. Key ops follow-ups I will own: 

- Validate capacity sizing model: run a throughput simulation for 4 x A100 equiv with the given spike windows and the requested P95=200ms; will share a latency curve by EOD tomorrow (Jun 20).
- Canary runbook: draft a two-week canary playbook with rollback triggers (error rate, latency delta, token-cost anomaly). I'll include test vectors and Prometheus/Grafana dashboards to monitor.
- Security evidence: Prod infra eng will prepare SOC2 summary + KMS integration notes; estimated delivery Jun 25.

Ben — can you prep a pricing sketch for 4 committed slots + 2-week canary that fits the $40k–$60k/mo target (include burst tariff)? Use conservative utilization assumptions for the sketch.

I'll mark tasks in the ops board and link in the mutual action plan Naomi will send.

—
Sean Gallagher
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Rourke <liam@auroraai.com>, Anjali Rao <anjali@auroraai.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AuroraAI dedicated compute — post-call summary & action map

Thanks Liam — appreciate the budget range and timing. Quick confirmation and next items: 

1) We will proceed with VPC + dedicated GPU pool (no air-gap for phase 1).
2) Sean will deliver the simulation and canary runbook (target Jun 20 EOD & Jun 22 for the runbook).
3) Ben to produce pricing sketch by Jun 21 morning to align with your procurement window.
4) Security evidence pack targeted Jun 25.

I created a short mutual action plan and pushed the DocuSign link for the preliminary SLA/POA here: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/aurora-sla-sign — if that looks OK, please have Anjali or your procurement contact sign and we'll schedule the canary kickoff for Jun 30.

Next meeting suggestion: Tue Jun 24, 11:00 PT for an internal sync + procurement check (30min). LMK if that works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
